### CVE-2010-0390
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-01-26 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 11169: Max's Image Uploader - Arbitrary File Upload (webapps/php, 2010-01-17, verified=1)

Unrestricted file upload vulnerability in maxImageUpload/index.php in PHP F1 Max's Image Uploader 1.0, when Apache is not configured to handle the mime-type for files with pjpeg or jpeg extensions, allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by uploading a file with a pjpeg or jpeg extension, then accessing it via a direct request to the file in original/.  NOTE: some of these details are obtained from third party information.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2010-0397
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-03-16 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 33755: PHP 5.3.2 'xmlrpc' Extension - Multiple Remote Denial of Service Vulnerabilities (dos/php, 2010-03-12, verified=1)

The xmlrpc extension in PHP 5.3.1 does not properly handle a missing methodName element in the first argument to the xmlrpc_decode_request function, which allows context-dependent attackers to cause a denial of service (NULL pointer dereference and application crash) and possibly have unspecified other impact via a crafted argument.

### CVE-2010-1128
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-03-26 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 33677: PHP 5.3.1 - LCG Entropy Security (dos/php, 2010-02-26, verified=1)

The Linear Congruential Generator (LCG) in PHP before 5.2.13 does not provide the expected entropy, which makes it easier for context-dependent attackers to guess values that were intended to be unpredictable, as demonstrated by session cookies generated by using the uniqid function.

### CVE-2010-1130
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-03-26 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 33625: PHP 5.3.1 - 'session_save_path() Safe_mode()' Restriction Bypass Exploiot (dos/php, 2010-02-11, verified=1)

session.c in the session extension in PHP before 5.2.13, and 5.3.1, does not properly interpret ; (semicolon) characters in the argument to the session_save_path function, which allows context-dependent attackers to bypass open_basedir and safe_mode restrictions via an argument that contains multiple ; characters in conjunction with a .. (dot dot).

### CVE-2010-1866
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-05-07 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 33920: PHP 5.3 - 'PHP_dechunk()' HTTP Chunked Encoding Integer Overflow (remote/php, 2010-05-02, verified=1)

The dechunk filter in PHP 5.3 through 5.3.2, when decoding an HTTP chunked encoding stream, allows context-dependent attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) and possibly trigger memory corruption via a negative chunk size, which bypasses a signed comparison, related to an integer overflow in the chunk size decoder.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:
- http://php-security.org/2010/05/02/mops-2010-003-php-dechunk-filter-signed-comparison-vulnerability/index.html [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2010-2094
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2010-05-27 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 33988: PHP 5.3.x < 5.3.2 - 'ext/phar/stream.c' / 'ext/phar/dirstream.c' Multiple Format String Vulnerabilities (remote/php, 2010-05-14, verified=1)

Multiple format string vulnerabilities in the phar extension in PHP 5.3 before 5.3.2 allow context-dependent attackers to obtain sensitive information (memory contents) and possibly execute arbitrary code via a crafted phar:// URI that is not properly handled by the (1) phar_stream_flush, (2) phar_wrapper_unlink, (3) phar_parse_url, or (4) phar_wrapper_open_url functions in ext/phar/stream.c; and the (5) phar_wrapper_open_dir function in ext/phar/dirstream.c, which triggers errors in the php_stream_wrapper_log_error function.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

- Exploit-DB 34950: PHP 5.3.2 - 'xml_utf8_decode()' UTF-8 Input Validation (remote/php, 2009-05-11, verified=1)
